market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI at ~$100 currently; for LOW $85, requires ~15% drawdown over remaining ~25 days. Iran ceasefire and sanctions easing on Iranian oil are bearish near-term — adds 1-2 mbd supply. OPEC+ also unwinding cuts. A 15% drop in a month happens ~30% of months, but bearish setup elevates this. Recent CNBC reports note already steep declines on Iran ceasefire news.
assessment.key_uncertainty: If ceasefire holds and OPEC+ keeps unwinding, $85 is very plausible; if ceasefire breaks, oil rallies fast.
